title: Apollo passive seismic network
note: Station locations are plotted from published lunar coordinates using a simplified near-side locator. This is not a terrain map or a raw seismic waveform.

instrument.name: Passive Seismic Experiment (PSE)
instrument.description: A long-period, three-axis seismometer plus a vertical-axis short-period seismometer at each station.

stations.note: First full ALSEP station. Its passive seismometer helped turn the Moon into a place scientists could monitor after the crew returned to Earth.
Added another listening point to the lunar seismic network, helping scientists compare signals recorded at separated landing sites.
Extended the network northward, giving researchers a wider geographic spread across the lunar near side.
Added an eastern station to the network. The four passive seismic stations operated until 1977.
